_note: Fields needed by the UIIC Motor Premium Calculator. Computed fields are derived by field-computer.ts — never ask for those. Source priority: 'rc' = RC OCR, 'policy' = prior policy OCR, 'chat' = conversation answer.

required_fields.label: Registration Number
required_fields.ask_question: What is the vehicle registration number? (e.g. TN07AB1234)
required_fields.purpose: Needed to determine Zone-A/B for premium rating. Also identifies the vehicle.

required_fields.label: Date of Registration
required_fields.ask_question: What is the date of registration on the RC? (DD/MM/YYYY)
required_fields.purpose: Portal field: dateOfPurchaseString. Determines vehicle age and depreciation band.

required_fields.label: Engine Cubic Capacity (CC)
required_fields.ask_question: What is the engine CC? (Visible on the RC — e.g. 1197, 998, 1498)
required_fields.purpose: Used to compute the CC band option value for the portal dropdown.

required_fields.label: Vehicle Class
required_fields.ask_question: Is this a private car or a two-wheeler (motorcycle/scooter)?
required_fields.purpose: Determines whether to select Private Car (18) or Motorcycle/Scooter (3) in the portal.

required_fields.label: Fuel Type
required_fields.ask_question: What is the fuel type — Petrol, Diesel, CNG, or Electric?
required_fields.purpose: Electric vehicles are excluded by UIIC. Also determines CC band vs KW band.

required_fields.label: NCB Percentage
required_fields.ask_question: What is the NCB (No Claim Bonus) from the previous policy? Typical values: 0%, 20%, 25%, 35%, 45%, 50%. Enter 0 if this is a new vehicle or no prior policy.
required_fields.purpose: Direct portal input. Reduces OD premium. 0% for new vehicles.

required_fields.label: Previous Policy Expiry Date
required_fields.ask_question: When does the current insurance policy expire? (DD/MM/YYYY) — this sets the new policy start date.
required_fields.purpose: Risk start date = day after expiry. If missing, risk start = today.

computed_fields._note: Zone-A = major metros, Zone-B = all others
New if no prior policy, Renewal otherwise
DD/MM/YYYY. One day after expiry, or today if no prior policy.

optional_fields.label: IDV (Insured Declared Value in ₹)
optional_fields.ask_question: Would you like to set a custom IDV (₹)? If not, we'll auto-calculate a fair market estimate.
optional_fields.purpose: Sets the maximum claim payout. Auto-computed from IRDAI depreciation if not provided.

optional_fields.label: OD Discount %
optional_fields.ask_question: Is any OD discount applicable? (Enter percentage, e.g. 5)
optional_fields.purpose: Optional own-damage discount applied before final premium.

excluded_conditions.message: UIIC's motor premium calculator does not support electric vehicles — their GI catalogue does not have EV manufacturer/model codes. Please select HDFC ERGO or Bajaj Allianz for an EV quote.
